name: Utility
description: Some specific dialogs for utility entities.

lines.name: Road Sign
lines.text: AAAB Village. Straight ahead, along the road.

lines.name: Narrator
lines.text: No name. No direction. No promise of what lies further down the road.

lines.name: Narrator
lines.text: I found a key in the chestbox. I wonder what it's for. It's probably for some other chestbox.

lines.name: Narrator
lines.text: Inside the chest, you discover old books and records of the Warriors’ Guild that once occupied this house.

lines.name: Narrator
lines.text: Among the texts, you manage to find the name of the northeastern house — “Assembly Hall.”
